referenceEncoder.note: Independently-generated ISO 15118-20 DC frames captured from a live Josev EVCC<->SECC Plug & Charge session (see docs/interop-runs/2026-07-21-iso20-dc-pnc-notls/). Josev encodes with EXIficient, which shares no lineage with the cbV2G oracle behind the other -20 vector files, so these are an independent conformance signal. Each carries Josev's own per-session SessionID (6FDD742705DA1225) and wall-clock TimeStamp -- unlike the cbV2G files' fixed zero SessionID -- so they are validated by decode -> re-encode byte-identity (JosevCuratedVectorTests), not by rebuilding the message from a fixed fixture.
